notes.title: Rope Cow 1.0.1 Update Notes
notes.content:
[1.0.1]

  * Fixes audio bug causing audio to spuriously stop until a checkpoint was reloaded.
  * Fixes player stuck on walls or staying invulnerable when using block transports.
  * Minor bug fixes to colliders, decoration and translation.
